name: ASCII Screensaver
author: Luci Evol
description: Multi-animation ASCII screensaver (30 animations) for Omarchy Quattro, triggered on idle via an omarchy.idle clone and rendered in a Chromium kiosk window per monitor.

barWidget.description: Quick-access button in the bar to open the ASCII Screensaver settings panel.

schema.label: Show bar icon
schema.description: Display a button in the bar to quickly open the settings panel. Can also be toggled from inside the panel's General page.
